verdict.rationale: The evidence describes stagewise as a standalone desktop IDE (downloadable for macOS, Windows and Linux) in which the agent runs and can itself execute shell commands. Nothing documents launching or running the coding agent from the user's terminal. One community comment mentions signing up 'via the CLI', but that concerns account creation, not running the agent, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal
